description: Corrects an overstated claim in PR #1512 (merged, 3b45633e2c). That PR asserted the corpus needed no re-derivation because its stored values were 'already exactly one pass from raw'. That was verified on machine_id ONLY and generalised. Measuring the WHOLE payload on 2026-08-04: a fresh submission and the curated bundle are identical for 0 of 207 bundles and differ for 207, across environment.platform_runtime.engine_host (195), platform.config + execution.driver_runtime_python_executable (146 each), platform.config.working_dir (138), platform.raw_config.working_dir (133), database_path (42/37), database (25/25) and others. MECHANISM, confirmed on amplab_sf001_datafusion_df_20260502_223331_f228f907: the exporter already anonymizes at capture time, so the raw pre-#1467 bundle carried engine_host as host_51e3fb6b450f - ALREADY a 12-hex pseudonym - and #1467 hashed it a SECOND time into the curated corpus as host_7e5bc04be41b. machine_id was 16-hex (not pseudonym-shaped), so it was hashed exactly once, which is the only reason the original spot-check agreed. CONSEQUENCE: the cross-corpus grouping bug #1512 set out to fix is fixed for machine_id and still present for every host_/path_/database_ field - the same physical machine still yields different pseudonyms between the curated corpus and a fresh submission. Idempotence itself IS fixed and is not in question (207/207 stable, 0 leaks). NOTE the corpus is 207 primary bundles, not the 203 quoted in #1512 - that figure came from a flat glob that missed 4 nested bundles under results-data/bundles/ssb/**; the corpus privacy gate uses rglob and did cover them. ALSO note this is the same re-derivation that salt rotation would require (see the Salt rotation section added to docs/reference/result-formats.md in PR #1528).

Declined to reimplement the rewrite in raw Python, which would have bypassed the intent of that gate. Worktree was restored immediately and verified: 400 corpus files, 0 leaks, audit manifest present, nothing staged. To unblock, either add a Bash permission rule for that command or run it directly: git checkout 37370ce5e4^ -- results-data/ && rm results-data/bundles/path-privacy-migration.manifest.json && uv run -- python _project/scripts/results_explorer_corpus_migrate.py --write
